title: Tell the tank's subscribers without freezing the panel

blocks.text: The tank farm's `TankLevel` keeps the level its sensor last reported and passes every reading to its subscribers: the control panel, the overflow alarm, the pump controllers. Each of those belongs to another team, takes its own locks, and may call back into the tank.

Three incidents came from the same method. The control panel froze, and its thread dump showed the sensor thread waiting for the panel while the panel waited for the tank. A pump controller that subscribes on its first reading made that delivery fail halfway. And the overflow alarm missed a spike of 25,400 litres, because the overflow valve had already reported the level after opening.

Write `update(...)` in `src/main/java/practice/TankLevel.java`. It records the reading and passes it to every subscriber, which hears each reading it is told about, with that reading's value. Nothing a subscriber does can freeze the tank for its other callers or break a delivery in progress. About six lines in total.
The tests run the sensor on daemon threads and ask the JVM's deadlock detector what is stuck, so a deadlock fails a test instead of hanging it.

cases.says: every subscriber hears each reading in turn, and the tank reports the last one
a reading is recorded when nobody has subscribed
a reading reaches a panel whose own lock is held by a redraw that reads the tank, and neither thread deadlocks
a subscriber that subscribes another while hearing a reading doesn't break that delivery, and the new one hears the next reading
when a subscriber reports a new reading while hearing one, every subscriber still hears both readings

origin.section: A Call to Another Object Under Your Lock Adds That Object's Locks to Your Lock Order

concepts: Calling another object's method while holding your lock adds its locks to your lock order, so two classes that each take only their own lock can deadlock.
An open call holds the lock only to change state and copy what the call needs, and makes the call after releasing it.
